ex.s: （1）What have scientists discovered with the help of mathematical models of food webs？

ex.s: The digital age also enables us to find people who share our interests, such as collecting model cars or playing an unusual instrument.
ex.t: 数字时代也使我们能够找到与我们有共同兴趣的人，例如收集模型汽车或演奏不寻常的乐器。

ex.s: Unsurprisingly, these new concepts inspire us to build new models of the universe.
ex.t: 不足为奇的是，这些新概念激励我们建立新的宇宙模型。

ex.s: One probable reason is that most climate models assume that the melting of permafrost is driven only by warming air.
ex.t: 一个可能的原因是，大多数气候模型假设永久冻土的融化仅由空气变暖所驱动。

ex.s: Mathematical models have also revealed that food webs may be unstable， where small changes of top predators can lead to big effects throughout entire ecosystems． In the 1960s， scientists proposed that predators at the top of a food web had a surprising amount of control over the size of populations of other species﹣including species they did not directly attack．
ex.t: 数学模型也揭示，食物网可能不稳定，顶级捕食者的微小变化会在整个生态系统引发巨大效应。20世纪60年代，科学家提出，食物网顶端的捕食者对包括它们不直接攻击的物种在内的其他物种种群规模有着惊人的控制力。

ex.s: Stephanie Dutkiewicz，a scientist in MIT's Center for Global Change Science，built a climate model that projects changes to the oceans throughout the century.
ex.t: 麻省理工学院全球变化科学中心的科学家斯蒂芬妮·杜特凯维奇建立了一个气候模型，预测本世纪海洋的变化。

ex.s: That is a good example of why — no matter how complex our models are or may one day be — we need direct observation of the natural world.
ex.t: 这是一个很好的例子，说明为什么——无论我们的模型现在或将来有多复杂——我们都需要对自然世界进行直接观察。

ex.s: Then, in the 1980s, Bob Johnson created the life story model of identity, in which he proposes that, as we go through life, these core features are built in with our memories to create a personal story through which we understand our lives.
ex.t: 之后，在1980年代，鲍勃·约翰逊创立了身份的人生故事模型，他在模型中提出，在我们经历生命时，这些核心特征与我们的记忆一起构建，以创造一个个人故事，我们通过这个故事来理解我们的生活。

ex.s: All these models are tools to deal with the unknown and to make discoveries.
ex.t: 所有这些模型都是应对未知和做出发现的工具。

ex.s: The model projects that currently blue areas with little phytoplankton could become even bluer.
ex.t: 该模型预测，目前浮游植物稀少的蓝色区域可能会变得更蓝。

ex.s: Dutkiewicz's model aims to project phytoplankton changes
ex.t: 杜特凯维奇的模型旨在预测浮游植物的变化

ex.s: If the field of ALife manages to reproduce life’s endless “creativity” in some virtual model, those same principles could give rise to truly inventive machines.
ex.t: 如果ALife领域能够在某些虚拟模型中复制生命无限的"创造力"，那么同样的原理可能会催生真正具有创造力的机器。

ex.s: And then, we can shift our inquiry from “Is the universe a computer simulation? ” to “Can we model the universe as a computer simulation? ” Modelling reality is what we do.

ex.s: It can be imagined that comparable to the process of building previous scientific models, developing the “computer simulation” metaphor-based model will also be a hugely rewarding exercise.
